purpose: What a document says about the risks of generative AI and who is responsible for what: which hazards it names, and which duties it puts on students, staff, the institution or providers. Each row has a verbatim quote and a flag for whether the quote itself names AI. Rules about what AI may be used for are in the uses schema, tools and data in the toolsdata schema, and academic misconduct in the misconduct schema.

risks.inaccurate_or_fabricated_output: AI output may be wrong, made up or out of date (hallucination, fabricated references, factual errors)
risks.bias_or_discrimination: AI may produce or repeat bias, stereotypes or unfair treatment
risks.privacy_or_data_exposure: information entered into AI may be stored, reused, leaked or seen by others
risks.copyright_or_ip_infringement: AI may reproduce or be trained on protected work, or put the user's or others' intellectual property at risk
risks.environmental_impact: AI uses energy and water or has other environmental costs
risks.overreliance_or_loss_of_skills: relying on AI may weaken learning, critical thinking or skills
risks.security_or_misuse: AI may be used for deception, deepfakes, cyber attacks, scams or other malicious use, or may have security weaknesses
risks.ethical_or_societal_harm: AI may cause wider ethical or social harm, including misinformation and exploitation of labour
risks.opacity_or_lack_of_transparency: how AI works or reaches its outputs is not visible or explainable
risks.reputational_harm: AI use may damage the reputation of a person or the institution
risks.inequity_of_access: unequal access to AI tools or skills may disadvantage some people
risks.wellbeing_or_safety: AI may be unsuitable or harmful for advice on health, wellbeing or safety

duties.accountable_for_output: the person remains responsible or accountable for what they submit or publish with AI help
duties.verify_output: check, fact-check or critically evaluate AI output before relying on it
duties.human_oversight: a human must keep judgement or review, for example no sole reliance on AI for marking or decisions
duties.use_ethically_and_responsibly: use AI ethically, responsibly, safely or transparently, stated in general terms
duties.comply_with_policy_and_law: follow the institution's policies and applicable law when using AI
duties.assess_risk_before_use: carry out a risk, impact or approval process before adopting or using an AI tool
duties.report_concerns_or_incidents: report misuse, incidents, breaches or concerns
duties.stay_informed_and_trained: learn about AI, take training or keep up with guidance
duties.keep_guidance_under_review: the institution reviews, updates or monitors its guidance and AI developments
duties.ensure_equitable_access: the institution commits to fair or inclusive access to AI tools or skills
duties.no_compulsion_to_use: students or staff are not required to use AI

bearers.staff: staff, including academics, markers and supervisors
bearers.institution: the institution, its leadership, faculties or services
bearers.provider: the AI vendor or tool provider
bearers.unspecified: the text does not say who bears it

strengths.must: an obligation (must, required, will be expected to)
strengths.should: advice or an expectation (should, encouraged, recommended)
strengths.will: a commitment by the institution (we will, the university commits to)
